Job description

Brand Ambassador Equation Events

We're hiring urgently looking for someone ready to start within the next two weeks.

If you love making people smile, thrive on details, and want to be part of an energetic team that brings cutting-edge tech to live events we want to talk to you.

Who Is Equation Events?
We're a group of talented, passionate people who help companies deliver unforgettable experiences to their event attendees often using VR and other immersive technology to make it happen. We're growing our team with people who share our energy for live events.

Our Culture
We're Hungry, Figure-It-Outers, In It To Win It, People People, Big Kids, and High Fivers. If that sounds like you, keep reading.

How the Role Works
As a Brand Ambassador, you're the face of the experience the outgoing, people-loving personality who gets attendees excited to step up and try what we've built. You'll strike up conversations, read the room, and turn a curious passerby into someone who can't stop talking about their experience. Beyond the energy you bring on the floor, you'll also own the on-the-ground logistics setting up and running VR and other tech-driven activations, and making sure every event runs smoothly from setup to wrap-up. This is a part-time role with heavy travel to event sites (travel costs covered).

You Will...

  • Own attendee satisfaction be the person who makes sure guests leave smiling
  • Lead event setup, including VR stations and other tech, making sure every detail is ready before doors open
  • Handle last-mile logistics across the US the final push that gets everything where it needs to be, on time
  • Create marketing assets on-site (photos, video, content) to capture the event for our team and clients
  • Run post-event reviews to help us get even better next time

You Bring...

  • An outgoing, people-first personality you genuinely enjoy talking to strangers and getting them excited
  • Proven experience managing live events or a similar fast-paced, detail-heavy role
  • Comfort with tech and gadgets VR experience is a plus, gamers encouraged to apply
  • A proactive, "figure it out" attitude you solve problems before they become problems
  • Comfort with a flexible, always-on-the-road schedule
  • The ability to walk, stand, kneel, lift up to 50-100 lbs, and be on your feet for extended periods
  • A valid driver's license and access to a car
  • Availability to start within two weeks

Ready to jump in? Apply now we're moving fast to fill this role.

This role requires someone highly motivated, detail-oriented, and energized by delivering great experiences for people.

The statements herein indicate the general nature and essential duties of this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities. Equation Events is an at-will employer.

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: $29.00 - $40.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Employee discount
  • Flexible schedule
  • Paid training

Application Question(s):

  • Are you available to start within the next two weeks?
  • Are you available to travel to different event sites across the US a few times a month? (Travel costs will be paid by the company)
  • What makes you excited for this role?
  • What makes you qualified for this role?

Work Location: In person
